information: - The band that received the “Best Holy Local Band” award in the Phoenix New Times Best of Phoenix 2006 is **Andrew Jackson Jihad**.

- “I Can’t Handle Change” – a track from Roar’s EP *I Can’t Handle Change* that gained popularity on TikTok in 2019 and 2024【1†L27-L32】【1†L54-L56】  
- “Christmas Kids” – a song from the same EP that went viral on TikTok in 2023【1†L71-L73】【1†L94-L100】

From the Roar (musician) Wikipedia entry:

- The page states: “During 2016, Evans joined band Andrew Jackson Jihad, which later rebranded to AJJ, as their drummer.” (shows that Owen Evans was drummer from 2016‑2021)【1†L30-L34】.

- The entry lists the song “I Can’t Handle Change” as a viral TikTok hit and notes it was released as part of the EP *I Can't Handle Change*【1†L75-L78】.

- In the ‘Charted and certified songs’ table, “Christmas Kids” is listed with a viral TikTok reference: “'Christmas Kids' – 45–58, 2023, went viral on TikTok.”【1†L105-L108】

These two songs—“I Can’t Handle Change” and “Christmas Kids”—are the ones that went viral on TikTok by the artist who played drums in Andrew Jackson Jihad from 2016 to 2021.
